summary: motorbike or scooter: frame, tank, seat and body panels on a fork and a swingarm, two wheel models; the steering axis runs through the headset and the rider's seat and grips match the anim group.

overall.summary: the whole bike, side and 3/4 views

front.summary: headlamp, fork, front mudguard, fairing nose

rear.summary: tail, tail lamp, plate, rear mudguard

sides.summary: frame, tank, side panels, footpegs, stand

wheels.summary: both wheels, brakes, fork lowers, swingarm end

notes: Rename items to the real design ('Front bumper with a centre air intake'), add what the design has with keys of your own (roof rack, bull bar, side steps), split an item when a reviewer could point at its halves.
Never drop a starter item silently: delete it only with a 'waived' entry {key, why} (asset.inventory reports dropped keys; the strict check blocks them).
Tag the built geometry with scene.tag (whole objects, or faces with a select) as you build; an item counts as built only when its own geometry carries its id and touches what it attaches to.

items.name: Frame
items.construction: spars or tubes swept from the headstock to the swingarm pivot (scooter: the step-through backbone)

items.name: Bodywork (fairing, side panels or leg shield)
items.construction: lofted soft panels welded into one body around the frame; scooter: leg shield and rear body

items.name: Fuel tank
items.construction: lofted tank on the frame top with knee recesses (scooter: under the seat, waive)

items.name: Front wheel
items.construction: mesh.lathe tyre, rim and hub

items.name: Rear wheel
items.construction: mesh.lathe tyre, rim and hub

items.name: Front fork
items.construction: fork legs and triple clamps; the steering axis passes through the headset inside the body

items.name: Swingarm
items.construction: arm from the pivot to the rear axle

items.name: Handlebars with grips and levers
items.construction: bar on the top clamp, grips at the rider's hands (bargrip), brake and clutch levers

items.name: Seat
items.construction: soft lofted seat at the rider pose height

items.name: Engine
items.construction: cylinders, head, cases and covers in the frame

items.name: Mudguards
items.construction: front guard on the fork, rear hugger or tail guard

items.name: Exhaust
items.construction: header pipe swept to a muffler at the exhaust dummy

items.name: Headlamp
items.construction: lens in a bowl or set into the fairing

items.name: Tail lamp
items.construction: lens set into the tail

items.name: Footpegs
items.construction: pegs or boards at the rider's feet

items.name: Number plate
items.construction: plate card on a hanger under the tail

items.name: Rear shock
items.construction: coil-over from the frame to the swingarm

items.name: Chain and sprockets (or belt or shaft)
items.construction: chain band from the gearbox sprocket to the rear sprocket with a guard

items.name: Mirrors
items.construction: heads on stalks from the bar or the fairing

items.name: Instruments
items.construction: speedo and tacho pods behind the bar

items.name: Indicators
items.construction: small amber lenses on stalks front and rear

items.name: Side stand
items.construction: stand folded under the left footpeg

items.name: Radiator or cooling fins
items.construction: radiator between the frame spars, or fins on an air-cooled cylinder

items.name: Brake discs and calipers
items.construction: lathe discs on the hubs with calipers on the fork leg and the swingarm

items.name: Cables and hoses
items.construction: brake lines and throttle and clutch cables swept from the bar to the fork and the frame

items.name: Airbox and battery box
items.construction: soft boxes under the seat

items.name: Brake and gear pedals
items.construction: levers ahead of the footpegs

items.name: Chain guard and hugger
items.construction: thin guard over the chain run

items.name: Grab rail
items.construction: rail behind or beside the seat

views_note: views name the close-up regions of 'blender preview --regions' (data/kit/regions/bike.json) that show each region; 'overall' with no views = the standard preview sheet
